stages.label: ss-fit fx

reasons: 256 sampling gap(s) exceeded 6ms; motion during those gaps was not judged

findings: half-pixel glyph: a 15px svg centered in the 70x21 span.ss-states__item sits on a half pixel, so it draws there while span.ss-states__item moves and hops sideways when it settles; size it 14 or 16px (even inside even) (11 frames from 3.6s)

lands on a transform: div.ss-expand__content "Tempo Run32 minWarm " comes to rest at the end of a transform, so its text hops a fraction of a pixel as it lands; keep it on a layer for good (will-change: transform), or scale only its surface
